title: Process Atlas manifest (process.yaml)
description: What the Process Atlas needs to list, find and link a process. It sits beside the engineering files of one process folder. For a ChemE-as-Code project, plant.yaml stays the engineering manifest; anything the catalog builder can derive from it (sheets, layout, LCA results) is not repeated here.

id.description: Stable slug, equal to the folder name. Used in URLs; never reuse or rename once listed.

summary.description: One or two sentences for cards and search results.

description.description: Longer Markdown text for the process page.

families.description: Process families from taxonomy/families.yaml (mapped to ISIC Rev.4 and NACE Rev. 2 there), e.g. air-separation, industrial-gases.

facets.description: Optional classification for filtering in the Atlas. Lowercase slugs; list only what the design has.

feedstock_basis.description: Where the process's material and energy inputs come from.

product_classes.description: Classes of the products, e.g. industrial-gases, fuels, fertilizers, polymers, chemicals, materials.

unit_operations.description: Unit operations in the design, e.g. cryogenic-distillation, adsorption, compression, reaction, electrolysis.

region.description: Region the design is for, e.g. generic, EU.

maturity.description: Design maturity (one of the glossary's axes; claimed in the library manifest): how far the design has been taken. concept/screening are research-level; basic-engineering and later carry engineering deliverables. The claim is capped by evidence: in an engineering project by the calculation maturity that `cheme maturity` evaluates into checks/maturity.json (sourced supports at most concept, balanced and predictive at most screening, engineering at most basic-engineering; a higher claim is the warning cheme.maturity-claim-exceeds); beside a Tier 0/1 LCI dataset at most concept (cheme.lci-tier-maturity). Not the review status (validation). Glossary: https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/core/blob/main/docs/concepts/glossary.md

validation.description: Review status (one of the glossary's axes; set by people only): who has checked the design, with the review records in reviews/. Automated checks passing is not a review. Independent of the design maturity (maturity) and the calculation maturity (checks/maturity.json). Glossary: https://github.com/ChemE-as-Code/core/blob/main/docs/concepts/glossary.md

basis.description: Design capacity in words and numbers, e.g. 500 t/d GOX.

lca.description: How the catalog gets LCA data. auto: from lca/ of a ChemE-as-Code project.

repository.description: Where the engineering files live, for 'open source files' links. path is relative to the library root.

publication.description: Whether the process may be published. A public build (--public) lists only status public; the preview build lists every process.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the license the process is published under, e.g. CC-BY-4.0.

exclude.description: Globs of process-folder paths kept out of its published viewer snapshot, in addition to the defaults (CONTRIBUTING.md). ** spans directories, * stays in one, a plain name is the file at the folder root.

family.description: Slug of taxonomy/families.yaml; keep this list equal to it (tests/test_registry.py checks).

chemical.description: Slug in chemicals/chemicals.yaml, or <slug>/<grade> for a grade of it (the graph joins by slug, the LCI export names the grade).

inventory_key.description: Row key in lca/inventory.csv (e.g. product:GOXP) when the flow has one.
